newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian Amcorp plans bonus, bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian Amcorp plans bonus, bond issue.

text.p: Malaysian financial and industry services group Arab-Malaysian Corp Bhd (Amcorp) said on Wednesday it has proposed a one-for-two bonus issue of up to 168.2 million new shares.
Amcorp has also proposed a 370 million ringgit bond issue with 67.3 million detachable warrants, it said in a statement.
The five-year redeemable unsecured bonds carry a 5.0 percent coupon.

Amcorp said the proposed bonds with warrants issue was intended to finance the subscription of Amcorp's entitlement to AMMB Holdings Bhd's proposed issue of 890 million ringgit loan stocks and bonds with warrants. The subscription will utilise 363 million ringgit of the total proceeds.
Amcorp will have an enlarged share capital of 571.97 million ringgit upon completion of the proposals.
